name: Uniform collapse (planar)
blurb: Gas (gamma = 5/3) moving toward the plane x = 0 at a speed proportional to the distance from it, u = -x, so that all of it would arrive at t = 1. It stays uniform, with no shock: its density grows as 1 / (1 - t). The open outer face cannot push gas in as the exact solution would, and a rarefaction runs in from it at the sound speed: the box reaches out to r = 3 so that it stays outside r = 0.9 (0.26 in the planar box) by t = 0.5.
